title: Talent and People Specialist, India
description:
**About Nightfall:**

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem - former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others.

**About the role:**

Nightfall builds AI-native data security: endpoint agents that run deep inside Windows, macOS and Linux, and the AI platform that detects sensitive data in real time. The engineers who build this are rarely on job boards. They maintain open-source security projects, ship kernel drivers at security companies, and ignore generic outreach.

As a Talent & People Specialist at Nightfall, you will find and hire these engineers for our Bengaluru team, and own the people operations that keep the team running well. About 70% of the role is technical recruiting and 30% is people operations. This is not a high-volume role: one great hire changes what our team can build, and you will see that impact directly.

**What you’ll do**

* Own hiring end to end for 5–8 engineering roles at a time across Engineering, Product and Support; sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offers and closing.
* Source beyond job boards: GitHub and open-source contributors, security communities, meetups, alumni networks, referrals and talent maps of target companies.
* Run technical first screens and write clear assessments of fit, gaps and probe questions that hiring managers trust.
* Build long-term relationships with senior engineers who are not looking yet.
* Partner with Leadership on compensation and offers.
* Own onboarding and off-boarding, employee records and the HRIS for the India team.
* Run day-to-day people operations, including payroll and benefits coordination, compliance and employee support.
* Support people programs such as policies, performance cycles and employee engagement, helping build a culture people want to stay in.
* Report on hiring pipeline, headcount and attrition to leadership.

**What are we looking for**

* A solid Recruiter first, with at least 4 years of full-cycle technical recruiting at a product company.
* Demonstrable track record of hiring Engineering, Product and Security Engineers across levels.
* Ability to explain why a candidate fits beyond keywords; for example, the difference between a backend engineer who lists "Kafka" and "microservices" and one who has designed, scaled and run a real-time streaming system in production.
* Proven sourcing skills beyond LinkedIn: Boolean and AI search, GitHub, communities and referrals.
* Understanding and flair for the People side; onboarding, engagement, and culture.
* Clear written communication and comfort working with US-based stakeholders. This will require you to be available in US timezones when needed.

**Nice to Have**

* Recruiting experience at a cybersecurity or endpoint security company.
* Experience as a founding Recruiter at a startup.
* Experience with AI sourcing tools (Juicebox, Metaview or similar) and ATS reporting.
* Experience running the hiring process on Ashby.

**Environment**

Nightfall AI takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

**Compensation**

Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits & perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter.
